title: peak-load-predictor
summary: A data-collection pipeline for a proactive cloud-scaling/peak-load prediction project that generates synthetic Azure workload time series to seed and augment training data. It defines table metadata and trains a PARSynthesizer model, then loads it to sample synthetic sequential workload data via SDV's sequential synthesis module.
